Erik —

Thanks for the clear list. Below is a concise activation playbook we can commit to; we'll attach the initial activation_manifest_v1.pdf for your records. High-level steps: 

1) Pre-signing / key escrow
   - Redwood will generate the activation manifest and sign it using our HSM-backed key held by two custodians (engineering lead + security lead).
   - Custodian names: Karthik Iyer (Principal Infra Engineer), Hannah Schmitt (Head, Private Deployments).

2) Transport & verification
   - You receive the signed manifest and a SHA256 digest bundle. Operators verify the digest locally: sha256sum <bundle>.
   - Run a deterministic manifest validation command we provide (manifest-verify --manifest activation_manifest_v1.pdf --pubkey redwood-hsm.pub).

3) Activation window & quarantine
   - Operator brings the site into network quarantine (airlock mode) for the 30-minute activation window. During this window only console access is allowed from the local operator jump host.

4) Smoke tests & rollback triggers
   - Post-activation smoke tests (3 checks) must pass within 10 minutes. If any smoke test fails, operator executes the offline rollback script (rollback-offline.sh) and notifies Redwood on the emergency channel.

5) Operator handback
   - Operator completes the handback checklist and returns custody to IslandCloud operations. We'll provide the handback XLSX template.

6) Audit & log collection
   - Activation produces an activation-record.json signed by the operator's key and Redwood's signing key. We retain the logs for 90 days by default; longer retention can be requested.

I've attached activation_manifest_v1.pdf (signed stub). Please confirm the operator identities and acceptance timeline — Jonas, can you confirm the exact smoke-test script names and the rollback command?

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt

Erik / Hannah —

Adding the low-level verification and emergency instructions so IslandCloud operators can paste directly into the offline jump host: 

Prechecks (operator):
- Confirm manifest signature: openssl dgst -sha256 -verify redwood-hsm.pub -signature activation_manifest_v1.pdf.sig activation_manifest_v1.pdf
- Verify bundle digest: sha256sum redwood_bundle_v2.tar.gz | grep <expected-digest-from-manifest>

Deterministic validation (single-command):
- ./redwood-offline-verify --manifest activation_manifest_v1.pdf --bundle redwood_bundle_v2.tar.gz --pubkey redwood-hsm.pub

Activation sequence (operator steps):
1) Place site into airlock mode: islandctl quarantine start --timeout 30m
2) Mount read-only bundle and run fs-integrity-check (integrity-check --bundle /mnt/bundle)
3) Run activation: islandctl activate --manifest activation_manifest_v1.pdf --operator-key /home/operator/key.pem --confirm
4) Run smoke tests: ./scripts/smoke_basic.sh && ./scripts/smoke_connectivity.sh && ./scripts/smoke_inference.sh

Rollback (if any smoke fails):
- Immediate offline rollback: sudo /opt/island/rollback-offline.sh --from-timestamp $(cat /var/run/activation_ts)
- Notify Redwood via emergency-ops@redwood.com and attach the activation-record.json

Key custody notes:
- Signed-key-rotation-notes.txt (attached) documents the custodian split, K-of-N signing policy, and HSM export restrictions. We require an explicit operator-signed activation-record.json to close the window.

Jonas — please confirm the standard operator-handback checklist fields (operator name, operator key fingerprint, local evidence hash).

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
